about: Made-up aligned pairs (no real sequence data) with the answers the Python package adjusted-identity 0.2.6 gives for them: score_alignment with its defaults, percent = round(identity * 100, 2). Generated 2026-11-15. The TypeScript port in src/adjustedIdentity.ts must give the same. The annotated score strings (scoreAligned) were added 2026-11-19 from adjusted-identity 0.2.11, which gives the same identity, mismatches and scored positions as 0.2.6 on every vector here.
